build.command: RUSTC_WRAPPER= RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER= CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PWD/target/tool-result-contract" just build pty

scope: Four new native PTY processes with isolated child HOME/ZDOTDIR/XDG config and fixture cwd; graceful shell exit then native dispose. No live user shell/config/store changed.
findings: nu/zsh/bash produce cwd and phase via existing marks; all lack explicit shell identity and integration in tool readback and raw read/screen/viewport/frame.
environment reports only configured executable and boot cwd; after cd sub it remains the initial directory.
unsupported /bin/sh keeps empty cwd/unknown phase; literal input produces a split-token marker visible on screen, with no false command integration report.
Attaching with control agent/start true preserves existing command history; this is not yet a proof of UI replacement, which the maintained fixture must add.
